notes: Topline: mid-market product analytics vendor building an AI copil ot for product managers. POC on hosted API (3 weeks) showed good quality, now negotiating Dedicated pricing and ramp schedule.

POC summary: hosted API used for chat + embeddings. Latency 95th ~160ms for short chat flows; embeddings at 10k/sec with batching. Team satisfied with quality - said 'answers are coherent and context retention looks solid.'
Key reqs: per-tenant data isolation, VPC-only egress, SOC2 + ISO desired, SSO/SAML, audit logs, 13 month data retention policy for logs. Need KMS integration for keys (Azure Key Vault preference).

Pricing talk: AE proposed 12-month committed Dedicated package. Discussed three commitment tiers: Tier A (base): $12k/mo commit (expected token throughput ~300M tokens/mo), Tier B: $25k/mo commit (~700M tokens/mo), Tier C: $45k/mo commit (~1.6B tokens/mo).

Burst/overage: agreed conceptually on burst to 2x committed capacity for short windows (business-critical events) with chargeable burst pool. Overage rate proposed = 1.4x published on-demand for Dedicated; customer asked for a 1.2x max cap if we can guarantee network QoS and KV cache warm start.
Ramp schedule: customer wants 3-quarter ramp: Q2 start at 40% commit, Q3 at 75%, Q4 full commit. Seeking monthly step-up credits if missed ramp; AE to surface ramp-credit language to finance.

SLA & credits: legal wants clear latency SLO for chat (p95 <200ms) and throughput floor. Discussed automatic fallback to hosted variants if Dedicated region outage; customer asked for cross-region failover costs and tests.

Security review: they ran red team checklist and flagged 'network egress controls' and 'audit log export frequency'. SE to provide architecture diagram + KMS integration notes. Security questionnaire in drive linked above.

Commercial ask: customer requests 10% discount off quoted committed rate in exchange for 18-month term and accelerated payment (quarterly in advance). Deferred to commercial; AE proposed a blended discount + free burst pool for first 90 days as concession.

POC metrics: latency, token cost per 1k tokens, cache hit rate (observed 22% prefix hit in POC), average tokens per conversation ~1.2k. They want Optimize suggestions to reduce per-token spend before final commit.

Quotes from calls: 'We need predictable unit economics — if cost jumps in a viral week we can't eat it' — Head of Platform. 'Would prefer a predictable per-seat or per-conversation price but can accept token commit if we get ramp protections.'
Decision makers: CTO (Anna Ruiz), Head of Platform (Marcus Nguyen), VP Finance (Lena Ortiz). Contract review will go to procurement and legal (in parallel).

Next steps captured: finalize committed tier selection (customer leaning Tier B), draft DIR + commitment exhibit, legal to push SLA/DPA redlines, schedule final pricing negotiation with finance (AE+SE+Customer Finance) week of 2026-03-08.

Open items: exact overage multiplier cap, definition of 'burst' windows (duration, triggers), telemetry retention and export formats, KMS key rotation responsibilities, testing window for failover playbook.

Internal notes: watch ARR math — Tier B commitment ties to ~$300k ARR if annualized; finance needs model for mid-year ramp and credits. Prepare counter-proposal: 8% discount + 60k token burst pool for first 90 days + 3-month step-up buffer.
